message:
Last week, we had a surprise power outage that turned into an unexpected family bonding moment. I quickly grabbed my trusty flashlight and powered up a few lanterns, but the real fun began when I opened our family group chat. 

Suddenly, my phone was buzzing with updates: my daughter was trying to cook dinner on her portable stove, while my son was sharing tips on how to keep the fridge closed longer. I even got a hilarious meme about candle safety from my sister! 

It reminded me that even in the dark, a little humor and connection can brighten up the situation. How do you keep the family spirit up during a blackout? 😄
